verses.1: A prayer for the Lord; all the earth rejoices in Him.
verses.2: Serve the LORD with joy, and come before Him with songs of praise.
verses.3: Know that Jehovah is the God who created us. To Him we belong, and to Him we will return.
verses.4: Let them enter his gates, let them enter the streets of his city. Praise his name!
verses.5: For it is good for Jehovah to have his kindness forever; his truth will last from generation to generation.
